pages.text: Day 3. I am done placing casings by hand. Set the multiblock controller down, use the $(item)Structure Assembler$() on it, and it builds every missing block, bottom-up, from casings in my inventory (free in creative).

Lesson learned: $(thing)sneak-use$() first for a dry run. Sparks mark the gaps, and I get a shopping list that counts what I already carry.$(br2)The assembler never breaks blocks - anything in the way is marked, for me to clear myself. It never places $(item)Interface Ports$() automatically either; I swap those in where I want them.

$(thing)Taking a structure apart$(): sneak-use the assembler in the air to switch it to disassemble mode (it glints while it is in it). Use it on a controller, then again within five seconds to confirm: every block of the structure's pattern - casings, ports, coils, glass, the controller last - comes back to your inventory, and anything that does not fit lands at your feet. Blocks that are not part of the pattern are never touched. Sneak-use on a controller in this mode lists what you would get back.
On a $(thing)tower of variable height$() (the Gas Centrifuge Cascade), using the assembler on a finished structure builds one more stage on top.
Use on a multiblock controller to build every missing block from your inventory. Sneak-use to preview what is missing.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
